items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: By uh Grant Clark, Edgar Leslie and Lou Handelman.

ctx.x: Tom was playing before them. You see uh Tom's father was a Browns band too. I've heard that. His father. I guess he taught the boys you know.

And you've got a lot of sheet music around. Oh. I guess some of this belongs to Tom too. All of that's yes. See a fool in love. Till then. Till then. Blue. Blue. Yeah. By uh Grant Clark, Edgar Leslie and Lou Handelman.

See I have all his books that we played in in Chicago. That is they read um what they called it orchestration. I have all the books of orchestration. See they had to play orchestration. And not just go and just grab it and the chorus and that song. I have the whole set. Even down to oboe. See Tom played beat bands. Oh yeah.
